subject.title: fix(msteams): avoid memory spikes from oversized certificate files

question: Should existing Microsoft Teams federated certificate bundles above 64 KiB become unsupported, and if so what maximum size should OpenClaw enforce?
rationale: The memory bound is valuable, but the chosen hard limit changes previously accepted operator configuration and no upstream Azure Identity maximum settles the compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve 64 KiB ceiling
options.body: Align certificates with the 64 KiB certificate/key ceiling used by adjacent bounded TLS work, then require shared-reader and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Select a larger ceiling
options.body: Choose an owner-supported limit based on realistic certificate-chain bundles while retaining bounded memory use.

options.title: Preserve unbounded compatibility
options.body: Decline a hard ceiling and pursue a different mitigation, accepting that mistaken paths can still cause large reads.

recommendation.title: Approve 64 KiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Align certificates with the 64 KiB certificate/key ceiling used by adjacent bounded TLS work, then require shared-reader and upgrade coverage.
